raw_text: While building the claim_check tests, the project's own documentation guard (test_docs_match_code) correctly flagged the new test file, because that test deliberately uses the real superseded formula strings as fixtures — it must prove that a Unicode minus sign and an ASCII hyphen normalize together. Rather than weaken the regex or obfuscate the fixtures, the chosen solution was an explicit per-file exemption list that is itself guarded: each exempt file must continue to declare a stated reason, so the exemption cannot silently outlive its justification the way the dead formula outlived its code. This established a principle that an exemption whose rationale has been deleted is exactly how a guard quietly stops guarding.
